---
name: agy-subagent-router
description: Route a bounded external coding task through agy.exe with current model discovery, bounded permissions, reasoning effort, and compact structured output.
---
[SPR/PIDGIN::ρ→max] 📋models 🤖delegate ⚡exec 📊eval
📋 モデル models ⊢ ∅ ⇒ 利用可能モデル一覧取得・確証 | `agy.exe models`
🤖 委譲 delegate ⊢ Task⊗Model ⇒ 外部エージェントハンドオフ作成・計画実行 | `agy.exe --print="<task>" --model <id> --effort <low|med|high> --mode plan --output-format json`
⚡ 実行 exec ⊢ Task⊗Files ⇒ 排他的ファイルスコープ外科的編集実行 | `agy.exe --print="<task>" --model <id> --mode accept-edits --output-format json`
📊 評価 eval ⊢ RunResult ⇒ 結果検証 & subagents_model_eval.json 記録 | SUCCESS ⊕ FAILED ⊕ ADVICE ⊕ ESCALATE

#SIGMA LRF/1

etl/finish.seq:
@seq 1
@entry FINISH
🏁 FINISH
Obj(Change ∘ Diff ∘ Checks ∘ Unknowns) → ArtifactSet
ArtifactSet → 🧾 TaskReport ∘ EvaluationJSON
⊢ valid(TaskReport) ∧ valid(EvaluationJSON) → 🔎 git.review
⊢ approval(VCS_WRITE,current_task) ⇒ 📦 git.commit → VCSReceipt
¬approval(VCS_WRITE,current_task) ⇒ VCSReceipt=N_A(pending_approval)
ERROR(git.commit) ⇒ VCSReceipt=FAILED(non_secret_cause)
⊢ approval(LIVE_WRITE,current_task) ∧ executable($env:LLM_MEMORY_BIN)
⇒ outside_sandbox(llm-mem.ingest(TaskReport)) → IngestReceipt=SUCCESS(receipt_id)
⇒ outside_sandbox(llm-mem.eval(EvaluationJSON)) → EvaluationReceipt=SUCCESS(receipt_id)
¬approval(LIVE_WRITE,current_task) ⇒ IngestReceipt=N_A(pending_approval) ∧ EvaluationReceipt=N_A(pending_approval)
missing_executable ⇒ IngestReceipt=FAILED(missing_executable) ∧ EvaluationReceipt=FAILED(missing_executable)
ERROR(llm-mem.ingest) ⇒ IngestReceipt=FAILED(process_error)
ERROR(llm-mem.eval) ⇒ EvaluationReceipt=FAILED(process_error)
MemoryReceipt := IngestReceipt ∘ EvaluationReceipt
⊢ approval(EXT_WRITE,current_task) ⇒ external_diary_mirror(memo/<task_id>/diary.md) → ExternalDiaryMirrorReceipt
¬approval(EXT_WRITE,current_task) ⇒ ExternalDiaryMirrorReceipt=N_A(not_requested)
ERROR(external_diary_mirror) ⇒ ExternalDiaryMirrorReceipt=FAILED(process_error)
⊢ final(IngestReceipt) ∧ final(EvaluationReceipt) ∧ final(ExternalDiaryMirrorReceipt)
⇒ 🧾 write-task-record(memo/<task_id>/{knowledge.md,diary.md,walkthrough.md,evaluation.json}, IngestReceipt, EvaluationReceipt, ExternalDiaryMirrorReceipt)
→ TaskRecordReceipt
🧾 RESULT.share(TaskReport ∘ VCSReceipt ∘ MemoryReceipt) → 🧑 Human → End(Conversation) ⊣ ⊤
AGENTS.md:
# LRF/1 bootstrap

READ+COMPILE [SIGMA](~/.harness/rules/BOOTSTRAP.lrf) before action; then load matching records from [MANUAL](~/.harness/rules/MANUAL.lrf) and [LOAD](~/.harness/rules/LOAD.lrf) after task classification. SIGMA and its routed modules are the only active user-policy source; `imported-gemini`, `archive`, and `backups` are non-authoritative provenance.

If SIGMA/link is missing, unreadable, invalid, structurally unknown, or equal-rank-conflicting: STOP the affected action and ask. Autonomous effects within the request: `RO_LOCAL`=local read/inspection, `RO_PUBLIC`=public read-only retrieval, `LW_SCOPE`=requested reversible workspace edit plus checks. Require explicit current-task approval for `EXT_WRITE`=external state/third-party message, `RELEASE`=deploy/publish, `LIVE_WRITE`=live DB/service write, `VCS_WRITE`=stage/commit/push/history rewrite, `DESTRUCT`=broad delete/unrecoverable overwrite, `CRED`=credential display/copy/rotation/new use, `CHARGE`=purchase/subscription/new charge, `PROD_DEP`=production dependency change. Unclassified effect: STOP. Never output or exemplify credentials.
